candidate.title: Provide GitHub PAT for upstream paperclip-create-agent PR
candidate.description:
Coder has prepared all four required edits for the upstream PR. The only remaining blocker is GitHub push credentials.

A GitHub personal access token (PAT) with repo scope is needed, or a configured SSH key for GitHub, injected into the Coder agent environment.
